job: Narrow a table or a list by one value, shown as a chip that opens a menu.
purpose: A soft chip that reads like a button at rest. With a value chosen it turns white, the value goes to full ink and a small x clears it. A filter bar lays out search, chips and actions and wraps instead of shrinking. Applied tokens show filters set from elsewhere. Clearing fires fd:change with value null.
useWhen: A table or log has a few filterable columns: status, endpoint, key.
Filters set by a link or with several values need to show as removable tokens.

avoidWhen.when: Picking several values from a long list.
Switching between a few views of the same data.
A category to apply to an item.

states.name: active
states.how: data-active when a value is chosen

states.name: expanded
states.how: aria-expanded on the trigger while its menu is open

states.name: cleared
states.how: fd:change with value null; the data-default label returns

variants.useWhen: A compact chip in a dense toolbar.

parts.role: The button that opens the menu.
The x button that clears the value.
The wrapping row of search, chips and actions.
Actions pushed to the end of the bar.
The search field in the bar.
The button that removes the token.

keyboard.does: Opens the menu from the trigger, or clears from the clear button.
